summary: iter41 frontend-only retest of the two iter40 open items, in a FRESH browser context with cache-busting query params. BOTH ARE FIXED. (2) Directory ProCard is now a role=link div: document.querySelectorAll('a a').length === 0, no validateDOMNesting warning, and both click targets navigate correctly. iter40's HandleAvailability failure was indeed a stale-bundle false negative.
